finding.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
finding.summary: query parameter file is joined against uploadsDir with filepath.Join, cleaned, and checked with strings.HasPrefix(full, uploadsDir) without appending the path separator to uploadsDir, so a value like ../uploads-backup/secrets.txt resolves to the sibling directory /srv/app/uploads-backup, which still matches the bare string prefix, and reaches http.ServeFile
